news-date: 2026-10-27

Open science is a core part our lab ethos. You might be aware that the Open Science Framework has made change to project and data storage going forward which means alternatives are needed.

With this in mind, we have created a Zenodo community for the lab, which will act as the repository for data, code and other project related outputs going forward.

The community can be found here: [https://zenodo.org/communities/mindresearchlab](https://zenodo.org/communities/mindresearchlab)

We are currently in the process of transferring files.

Zenodo is build and operated by CERN and OpenAIRE and uploads are stored in CERN’s Data Centre. Every upload to Zenodo is assigned a Digital Object Identifier (DOI), to make them citable and trackable.

We will maintain the links to archived OSF projects on the lab website. Where projects cross over from OSF to Zenodo, we will provide backward and forward linking to maintain provenance. 

Zenodo is primarily a data storage tool. It does not currently have pre-registration capability. As such we will operate a hybrid approach with pre-registrations on OSF and project outputs on Zenodo.
